# Settings getter (active profile)

Stock settings getter; with setting 63153 it returns the active colour profile.

**Category:** function · **Address:** `0x60063380` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [om3 firmware 1.1, build 1100](../firmware/om3-1100.md) · **Cameras:** [OM SYSTEM OM-3](../cameras/om3.md)

With setting id 63153 it returns 1 to 4 for COLOR1 to COLOR4. The same getter reads the white-balance shift keys.

## Observations

- **Physical camera** ([Caduceus for OM-3](../projects/caduceus-om3.md)): Listed under Proven on the camera in the OM-3 developer notes. Source: [Caduceus OM-3 developer notes](../sources/om3.devnotes.md).
- **Static analysis** ([OM-Emu](../projects/om-emu.md)): Matched to the E-M1 II camera-state read by OM-Emu's port table; called capture-safe there. Source: [OM-Emu study of Caduceus OM-3](../sources/emu.caduceus-om3.md).
